historic_survey.rating_note: The survey reports ratings from the 1976 citywide architectural survey on a 0-5 scale, 5 being individual significance of the highest degree. It gives no scale for the Carey & Company or UMB survey ratings, so those are recorded here but not shown on the page.

historical_record.description: Headquarters of Officers for Justice, the African American police officers' association whose class action against the city ended in a consent decree; it still owns and operates from the building. Identified in 2024 as eligible for local landmark, California Register or National Register designation.
